content.short: JustaName provides dApps with scalable digital identity infrastructure through easy-to-use development kits.
content.description: JustaName provides scalable digital identity infrastructure for dApps through an easy-to-use development kit. Using the kit, platform builders can add their own digital identity layer, issue free subnames, and verify users with verifiable credentials. It also supports plugins such as POAP, EFP, and Talent Protocol, enabling richer identity features and flexible integration for developers across different workflows and ecosystems.
content.meta: JustaName enables dApps to integrate scalable digital identity infrastructure with easy dev kits. Discover JustaName and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
